name: Conditional Antimatroids Are Strictly Dismantlable Ample
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every conditional antimatroid has a corner peeling, but some dismantlable ample classes have no conditional-antimatroid orientation.
proof: Ordering a conditional antimatroid by nondecreasing set size makes each newly added member a corner of its prefix. The agreeing-blocks class is geometrically realizable and ample, hence dismantlable ample, while its Horn-renaming defect is one; the zero characterization therefore excludes every conditional-antimatroid orientation.
